meta.name: Kai Wang · AI 交互设计作品集 / Dala-derived Design DNA
meta.description: 依据用户提供的 DESIGN.md 规格建立三维设计 DNA，并适配真实项目案例、中文阅读与 1920 × 1080 PDF。此文件描述作品集外层设计，不重绘或改色原产品界面。

source_references.method: 直接采用文档中明确给出的 token；没有访问到原始 Variant 页面，也没有执行参考图像取色。

meta.source_integrity: measured_palette 和 measurement 是可选字段，因未对参考图取色而省略。文档里两处/多处不合法的 #15846 均依据同一文档有效 token 统一为 #15846e；不复制源品牌名称或产品文案。
meta.scope: 网页首页、四个案例、关于页、17 页主 PDF 与轻量 PDF。素材索引、历史证据、设计规格辅助页及截图内部 UI 保留来源语义。

adaptations.fonts: 使用文档允许的 Inter 替代 PPNeueMontreal；中文使用本地 Noto Sans SC 子集（CSS 名 Folio），正文 200，标题 400。Inter 从保留的 variable 源生成同字形 static 200/400/600 woff2，以使 Chrome PDF 输出嵌入 TrueType 而非 Type3；不依赖远程字体。
adaptations.display: 参考 display 113px / heading 78px；网页封面用 clamp(56px,6.5vw,96px)，打印封面 104px、案例首屏 78px、证据页 58px。中文增加行高以防重叠。
adaptations.layout: 参考网页 max-width 1280px；实际外框 1472px 包含内边距以给产品截图留足空间，打印外框 1920px、左右 96px；移动端 800px 以下单列。
adaptations.content: 参考禁止 hero 产品图应用于作品集总封面；具体案例必须展示真实产品界面。截图不添加假设备、渐变、合成装饰或虚构结果。
adaptations.rounding: 保留 24px 主按钮；截图主视觉采用 12px、首页 18px，证据裁图 0px，避免裁掉界面内容。
adaptations.effects: 用确定性 SVG 三角形代替未经获取的源站粒子资产；不宣称复刻源实现。仅整组慢速 transform，无 WebGL 和指针物理。打印和 reduced motion 静止。
adaptations.evidence: 案例证据使用二至四列以便同屏比较；首页保持交替两栏、无卡片面板。

color.palette_type: neutral monochrome foundation with violet, amber and teal accents

primary.role: 正文主层级、标题、主按钮文字

secondary.role: 章节眉题、关键人类决策、次级文本链接

accent.role: 唯一实心主按钮颜色、标记和装饰粒子

neutral.usage: 从浅到深排列。白色主文字，#bdbdbd 支持文字和说明，#9a9a9a 元信息，#000000 页面底色。

color.contrast_strategy: 纯黑底保证白/灰文本对比。紫色按钮白字。语义 success/error 是预留映射，参考未提供错误态；作品集不新增状态控件，错误必须用文字解释，不能仅靠颜色。青绿只作装饰，不作小字。

font_families.heading: Inter, Folio (Noto Sans SC), sans-serif
font_families.mono: ui-monospace, monospace (reserved; not used in portfolio narrative)

typography.font_style_notes: 几何无衬线，标题 400 与正文 200，通过尺度与留白形成层级。Inter 从本地 variable 源生成真实 200/400/600 静态字重 woff2；中文 Noto Sans SC 真实 200/400 子集。静态实例保留同字形并改善 PDF 字体嵌入。英文采用简洁常规大小写，中文不强制 uppercase。源文档导航允许 400 或 600；实际导航 400，字标 600。

spacing.section_rhythm: 首页大段之间 144px，段内 24–36px；案例页顶部 72px / 底部 60px；PDF 顶部 72px / 左右 96px / 底部 48px。少量 8/10/14/16px 为字号和图注光学适配。

layout.grid_system: CSS Grid asymmetric two-column editorial layout; flex vertical reading groups
layout.max_content_width: 1472px including web gutters; PDF canvas 1920px with 1728px content width
layout.columns: 首页 2 栏交替；封面 .95fr:1.35fr；证据对比 2–4 栏；移动端主要 1 栏
layout.alignment_tendency: asymmetric, left-aligned type, consistent outer grid

border_radius.large: 18px home project images; 24px reference component token

shape.border_usage: none on cards, sections, screenshots and navigation; visible keyboard focus retained
shape.divider_style: none; spacing and typographic hierarchy separate groups

elevation.depth_cues: scale, opacity and chromatic density in decorative constellation only

iconography.style: small outlined triangle brand mark plus text arrow links; no generic AI icon library
iconography.stroke_weight: constellation paths 0.8px, ambient 0.7px in SVG viewBox
iconography.preferred_set: inline SVG and simple Unicode arrows; no external icon set

motion.easing: ease for hover; ease-in-out for constellation
motion.philosophy: minimal functional plus one quiet decorative loop; static in print and reduced-motion

components.button_style: One filled #8052ff action per view, white 400 text, 24px rounded pill; secondary actions plain white/amber/gray text. No gradient or drop shadow.
components.input_style: No portfolio form. Original app inputs remain inside authentic screenshots and keep source styling.
components.card_style: No background panel, border or shadow. Images and captions separated by whitespace.
components.navigation_pattern: Transparent horizontal header on black; identity left, short text navigation right; case jump links use quiet gray. Mobile wraps compactly.
components.modal_style: No portfolio modal or lightbox introduced. Original product dialog UI is documented in screenshots only.
components.list_style: Unboxed numbered decisions and horizontal state axis; amber identifies deliberate human action.
components.component_notes: Project overview uses a small image index. Case pages may use parallel evidence columns; this is an intentional adaptation from the reference landing page to an interview portfolio. Screenshot content is preserved as evidence.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: Colored triangles suspended on a black stage; projects presented as clear visual evidence.
aesthetic.era_influence: Contemporary geometric web editorial, based on the supplied Dala style description.

visual_language.complexity: minimal outer UI, real product complexity inside screenshots
visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous negative space; no filler cards or decorative tags
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: large left-aligned headings balanced by one broad product image or constellation
visual_language.focal_strategy: single main visual per section; evidence progressively elaborates decisions
visual_language.contrast_level: high contrast monochrome with small saturated accents
visual_language.texture_usage: none; no grain, glass, or artificial material

composition.hierarchy_method: scale, weight contrast 400/200, spatial isolation and restrained color
composition.flow_direction: left-to-right desktop; top-to-bottom mobile; alternating feature alignment on homepage
composition.grouping_strategy: semantic proximity and repeated outer grid, not boxed containers
composition.negative_space_role: separates claims and evidence, gives screenshots breathing room

imagery.photo_treatment: No invented lifestyle photo. Actual product screenshots use natural proportions and purposeful crops; no recoloring.
imagery.illustration_style: Deterministic vector triangle constellation on cover only.
graphic_elements: QR codes for working local deliverable links
imagery.pattern_usage: sparse ambient triangles around the cover cluster; no page-wide repeated texture
imagery.image_shape: natural screenshot proportions; small rounded main views, square-corner evidence crops

interaction_feel.feedback_style: visible focus ring, text color change, modest button opacity change
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: primary action opacity .85; navigation white; project title amber
interaction_feel.loading_style: native image loading and locally hosted font swap; no animated skeleton

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: direct, first-person where supported, evidence-based Chinese
brand_voice_in_ui.formality: professional and conversational; no exaggerated capability claims
brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: short concrete actions: 看作品、查看案例、下载作品集
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Do not substitute blank app screens for featured product imagery; unresolved personal facts remain TODO(Kai) in supporting questions documentation.
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: Name the observed state and next available action; distinguish actual observed failure from untested edge case.

overview.fallback_strategy: Static SVG with no extra runtime dependency; group animation disabled in print and prefers-reduced-motion. The same vectors remain as static art.
overview.primary_technology: server-rendered SVG paths plus CSS transform animation

background_effects.description: Solid #000000 canvas; ambient outlined triangles are part of the cover SVG, not an animated background surface.

particle_systems.description: Organic cloud of 1050 deterministic outlined triangles plus 70 sparse ambient triangles. Positions created at build time from a fixed seed; whole group rotates and scales gently.

params.size_range: cloud half-width 1.7–5.3 SVG units; ambient 2–5 units
params.movement_pattern: cloud rotate(-3deg) scale(.97) to rotate(3deg) scale(1.02), 14s alternate; ambient static
params.color_behavior: fixed seeded selection from violet, amber, teal, silver and white; no animated color shifts
params.spawn_area: 1040 × 740 SVG viewBox; cloud centered near (520,370), ambient throughout viewBox

3d_elements.description: No live 3D or synthetic product render in the portfolio. Home case may show authentic screenshots of its own 3D room.

scroll_morphing.description: No scroll-driven shape changes; standard document scroll.

text_effects.description: Text remains selectable and readable; no split-character or animated text.

cursor_effects.description: Keep platform cursor and normal link affordance.

image_effects.description: Preserve actual screenshot pixels and proportions. Basic fit/crop only; no generative replacement, perspective warp, glow or hover distortion.

canvas_drawings.description: Cover illustration uses SVG; no Canvas rendering context.

svg_animations.description: One CSS transform loop on the constellation group; paths do not morph or individually update.

params.animation_method: CSS keyframes cloud-breathe 14s ease-in-out infinite alternate

visual_effects.composite_notes: Source describes a brain-shaped multicolor particle cloud but provides no source asset or executable effect. This portfolio uses an original deterministic SVG interpretation in the same palette, not a claimed extraction of the source animation. SVG avoids added WebGL libraries and remains vector-sharp in PDF. Product screenshot colors are evidence and intentionally excluded from the outer-shell palette restriction. Disabled effect categories are retained in JSON for complete schema traceability.
